verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents native tool calling through the OpenAI functions and tools API across multiple backends. An autoparser detects the tool-call format for GGUF models trained with tool support, with no configuration needed. Nothing in the pack covers reasoning-parser support (e.g., extracting reasoning or thinking content), so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: reasoning-parser support, independent or hands-on corroboration of tool calling, per-backend depth and limits of the autoparser.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use native tool-calling and reasoning-parser support in my requests

citations.quote: LocalAI supports running the OpenAI functions and tools API across multiple backends.
No configuration required - the autoparser detects the tool call format for any ggml/gguf model that was trained with tool support.
